Fresh
Jan 2020 • Couples
Wtf. I'm fussy and critical. EAT HERE beef pad Thai 80k best pad Thai in the WORLD.

 So incredibly affordable for large plate of 12 fresh oysters, a plate of 15 small crayfish, beef pad Thai, a beer and a mango banana smoothie, 350k vd!!! Around $20 for us. Everything was fresh oh the seafood! Outdoor seating with fairy lights hanging in trees across the street right on the water.
Food came out in good timing even though there were a few full tables. And the owner speaks good English and recommended some activities that reflect an authentic price. His wife is the chef, she went to culinary school and it surely does show! So nice to not be ripped off or sit on grubby tables like Hanoi, loved that too but now this is living Barry!!
